acceptanceCovered: transcript pages by seq and segments can be corrected only when the meeting is not live or processing — proven by transcript.service.ts's EDITABLE list (queued/ready/failed only) enforced under the same row lock as every other meeting writer, and transcript.e2e.spec.ts's live/paused/processing 409 cases; mobile's real-transcript-screen.tsx consumes the same paged /segments contract

editing never re-runs the pipeline by itself and the meeting reports unprocessed edits — proven by transcript.service.ts.update() only setting text/is_edited/edited_at (no pipeline call), hasUnprocessedEdits() comparing edited_at to pipeline_started_at, and meeting-detail-hero.tsx/real-transcript-screen.tsx surfacing has_unprocessed_edits and prompting reindex only after explicit user confirmation; use-segment-mutations.ts now also explicitly invalidates meetingQueryKey on save so the flag refreshes without relying on remount timing

reindex changed after edits is scoped to the edit window and reindex after failure skips succeeded steps — proven by reading pipeline-control.service.ts's reindex() SQL character-by-character: resume (failed+changed) resets only status='failed' rows and leaves pipeline_changed_since untouched; ready+changed resets all rows to pending scoped by pipeline_started_at as the changed window; both paths covered by pipeline-control.e2e.spec.ts

export produces Markdown and HTML with chosen sections and a note when the summary is not ready — proven by export-document.ts/render-html.ts's per-section assembly and NOT_READY_NOTE fallback, verified against injection (both escapers traced against #, *, <script>, leading -) and covered by export.e2e.spec.ts including the not-ready-summary case

ending a meeting starts a pipeline run that executes steps in order and never reports ready without all steps succeeding — proven by PipelineEngine.advance()'s nextStep()-then-completeRun() sequencing, the explicit no-fake-ready pause at an unregistered handler, and pipeline-engine.integration.spec.ts running against real Postgres+Redis+BullMQ including the new mid-run-delete case (a step still running when its meeting is hard-deleted finishes as a no-op: markSucceeded returns false, advance() never runs, embed never enqueues, processing_jobs cascades to zero rows)

a failing step is retried 3 times with growing waits and then fails the meeting naming the step — proven by STEP_ATTEMPTS=4/retryDelayMs (2s/8s/32s, unit-tested), the attemptsMade+1>=maxAttempts final-attempt check verified against BullMQ 6.3.6's own job.js source, and failStep() writing the step name into meetings.failure_reason

the meeting ready push is sent exactly once per meeting with generic text and honours the user setting — proven by MeetingReadyNotifier's single conditional UPDATE ... WHERE ready_notified_at IS NULL claim, the hardcoded generic title/body (no meeting content), the notification_settings.meeting_ready_push check, ExpoPushClient's bounded 429/5xx retry so throttling doesn't silently burn the one-shot claim, and pipeline-control.e2e.spec.ts's exactly-once/dead-token/setting-respected cases

every Gemini call records a usage row with token counts and a spent budget blocks calls — proven by GeminiClient.generateText() calling assertWithinBudget() before and usage.record() after every call unconditionally, the AbortSignal now honored end-to-end through withSlot's queue wait (a timed-out step's queued call is rejected rather than billing after the fact, unit-tested in gemini.client.spec.ts), QuotaExceededError extending NonRetryableStepError so a spent budget fails fast, and usage-tracker.integration.spec.ts

mobile library, detail and transcript screens use the real API including delete undo and export — proven by src/api/meetings.ts calling the real endpoints with zero redeclared wire shapes; useDeleteMeetingWithUndo's setTimeout-gated single DELETE call (traced for the leave-screen and double-delete races, both handled correctly); useMeetingRoomSocket's function-form auth token plus connect_error/disconnect-driven refresh-and-reconnect recovery (use-meeting-room-socket.test.tsx's token-expiry-recovery suite exercises TOKEN_EXPIRED, server-initiated disconnect, a dead refresh token, and an ordinary disconnect that must NOT trigger recovery); push-token unregister now called from useLogoutMutation/useDeleteAccountMutation's mutationFn before the token is cleared, timeout-bounded; export files deleted in finally after the share sheet settles; and transcript search auto-fetching remaining pages (capped at 50) with a visible "searching" state when a query has zero local matches — 763 mobile unit tests plus the backend's 80 e2e tests exercising the endpoints these screens call
regressionChecked: meeting-processing job id format changed to meeting-run — runJobId/stepJobId now embed pipeline_run; verified startRun/current/stepWrite all guard on pipeline_run matching, so a job from a stale run is a safe no-op rather than corrupting a newer run

end and abandoned sweep now increment pipeline_run — verified in meetings.service.ts (end()) and abandoned-meeting.job.ts (closeIfStillAbandoned()), both also set pipeline_scope='full' and pass the new run number through enqueueAfterCommit

PATCH /meetings blank title now reverts to default instead of 400 — verified update-meeting.dto.ts's Length(0,200) change, meetings.service.ts's defaultMeetingTitle() fallback, and the dedicated e2e case

BullMQ root config reads BULLMQ_PREFIX — verified jobs.module.ts's forRootAsync passing prefix through, and that PipelineModule/MeetingsModule's registerQueue calls share the same global connection (no second forRootAsync introduced)

e2e harness isolation from a running dev server — verified test-support/e2e-app.ts threads BULLMQ_PREFIX into the spawned test server's env, isolating its queues from a developer's `make dev` instance on the same Redis

meeting deleted mid-run — new integration test (pipeline-engine.integration.spec.ts) proves a step already running when its meeting is hard-deleted finishes as a no-op: no embed job enqueued, processing_jobs cascaded to zero rows, matching the store-guard behavior traced by code-reading in the prior pass

removing the reactive push-unregister from usePushNotificationsLifecycle does not leave a gap — verified registerForPushNotifications (the other half of that hook) is untouched, and the only removed code path was the one already proven to always fail (unauthenticated DELETE); use-push-notifications-lifecycle.test.tsx no longer asserts the old reactive-unregister behavior, confirming it was deliberately removed rather than silently broken

findings.summary: socket auth was a static object and no disconnect/connect_error handler existed, so an expired-token disconnect could never recover — FIXED: auth is now a function re-read on every (re)connect, connect_error/disconnect run a single-flight refresh then reconnect, rejoin happens on every connect, and a dead refresh token stops recovery via a `stopped` flag; verified against BullMQ-analogous edge cases (dead refresh token, ordinary disconnect, non-auth connect_error) in use-meeting-room-socket.test.tsx

push-token unregister-on-logout fired reactively after clearTokens() had already wiped the access token, so the DELETE always went out unauthenticated and failed silently — FIXED: unregisterCurrentPushToken() now runs inside useLogoutMutation/useDeleteAccountMutation's mutationFn, before clearTokens(), timeout-bounded at 3s so a hung call can't block logout; verified the reactive call site was removed (not duplicated) in use-push-notifications-lifecycle.ts

exported Markdown/PDF files were never deleted after sharing, accumulating personal content in the app cache — FIXED: both paths delete the temp file in a finally block after Sharing.shareAsync settles (success or failure); the iOS early-resolve trade-off (share sheet dismissal vs. target app finishing the read) is stated in a comment rather than silently accepted

transcript search only searched already-loaded pages and FlatList.onEndReached never fires on an empty filtered list, so a match beyond the loaded pages reported as 'no results' — FIXED: a dedicated hook auto-fetches remaining pages (capped at 50) whenever a search has zero local matches and more pages remain, with a visible searching-state banner instead of a bare empty state

segment edit invalidated only the segments query, relying on default refetch-on-mount for has_unprocessed_edits to refresh — FIXED: now explicitly invalidates meetingQueryKey alongside segmentsQueryKey
GeminiClient's concurrency semaphore ignored AbortSignal, letting a timed-out step's queued Gemini call run and bill after the step already failed — fixed and verified in the prior follow-up pass
BullMQ step/run workers had no explicit concurrency, defaulting to 1 per queue system-wide and making GeminiClient's own maxConcurrency unreachable — fixed and verified in the prior follow-up pass

raw exception messages flowed unfiltered into processing_jobs.error_message and back out through GET /meetings/:id/status — fixed and verified in the prior follow-up pass (ExplainedStepError whitelist)

stall threshold equalled the step timeout and the sweep ran only every 15 minutes, allowing up to ~25 minutes of a stuck meeting before recovery — fixed and verified in the prior follow-up pass (5-minute threshold and sweep)
Expo 429/5xx responses were treated as a hard failure with no retry, silently losing the one-time meeting-ready push under transient throttling — fixed and verified in the prior follow-up pass
